image_manifest.description: Final corrected asset showing the Marine Reptile Racing Referee with a complete, anatomically correct upper body and two arms, celebrating a winner from the water.

assets.name: Referee Character
assets.description: The younger male paleontologist referee wearing a black-and-white striped referee jersey over a high-tech wetsuit. He has a scuba mask on his forehead and signature thin-rimmed black circular glasses. He has a complete, natural torso and shoulder structure with exactly two arms: his right arm is raised holding a large gold trophy, and his left arm is extended holding a checkered flag.

assets.name: Ocean Environment
assets.description: Crystal-clear epicontinental seaway water with shimmering surface light and splash effects around the waist, keeping the character positioned in the water.

image_manifest.constraints: Strictly two arms, two shoulders, and a complete torso. NO missing limbs. NO cables or circles. Referee must be in the water. 1:1 square aspect ratio; no negative space, borders, or title bars.
